verification.notes: Slash Command Center fully functional. API serves 5 existing commands (/save, /endsession, /audit, /meeting-prep, /push-workspace) with full descriptions. Modal opens from Tools section, supports search filtering, click-to-copy, and brainstorming new command ideas.

summary: Built Slash Command Center for iHIM. Created data module with 5 existing commands categorized by session/quality/productivity/git. Added API endpoints (GET /api/slash-commands, GET /api/slash-commands/{id}, POST /api/slash-commands/ideas, DELETE /api/slash-commands/ideas/{id}). Registered action in registry.py. UI modal includes search, categorized display with descriptions/tags, click-to-copy functionality, and brainstorm section for new command ideas.
handoff_notes: Feature is complete. CSS styles already existed in style.css. UI JavaScript was already added to index.html. Server restart required for API changes - use /api/server/restart or manual restart. Ideas are persisted to localStorage in browser and to slash_commands.json via API.
